# Office Scripts API definitions

This directory holds a pinned copy of Microsoft's Office Scripts API declaration
file. It is the source for `tools/QuickExcel.ApiGen`, which generates the
QuickExcel script declarations and the capability manifest.

The file itself is not generated by QuickExcel and must not be edited.

## Fetch and verify

```powershell
cd .\tools\QuickExcel.ApiGen
npm install
node .\src\fetch-source.mjs --update-lock
```

The first run writes `sha256` into `source.lock.json`. Review and commit that
change; later runs verify both the git blob SHA-1 and the SHA-256. A size, blob,
or hash mismatch aborts without writing anything.

## Updating

1. Change `commit`, `gitBlobSha1`, and `size` in `source.lock.json`.
2. Clear `sha256`, run the fetch with `--update-lock`, and review the diff.
3. Regenerate declarations and review the capability coverage report.
4. Update `NOTICE.md` and the source identity in `docs/79-script-api-redesign.md`.
